spec.title: Production Information - ${focus_machine}
spec.description: 7-day Day & Night shift performance replicating the physical Ta Liang DG CNC screen, with CSV export

spec.rawSql:
WITH machine_target AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    NULLIF(${focus_machine:singlequote}, ''),
    NULLIF(${machine_id:singlequote}, ''),
    (SELECT equipment_id FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1)
  ) AS eqp_id
),
dates AS (
  SELECT 
    m.eqp_id,
    (COALESCE(MAX(e.event_time::date), CURRENT_DATE) - (i || ' days')::interval)::date AS prod_date
  FROM machine_target m
  LEFT JOIN public.machine_event e 
    ON e.equipment_id = m.eqp_id 
   AND e.event_code IN ('0209', '0201')
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 6) AS i
  GROUP BY m.eqp_id, i
),
shift_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    m.eqp_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN e.event_code = '0209' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.event_time) BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN (e.event_time::date - 1)
      WHEN e.event_code = '0201' THEN (e.event_time - INTERVAL '8 hours')::date
      ELSE e.event_time::date
    END AS prod_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN e.event_code = '0209' THEN (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM e.event_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
      ELSE (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (e.event_time - INTERVAL '8 hours')) < 12 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
    END AS shift_num,
    SUM((regexp_match(e.event_message, 'Run Hits:\s*([0-9]+)'))[1]::bigint) FILTER (WHERE e.event_code = '0201') AS hits,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM substring(e.event_message FROM 'Online:\s*([0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})')::interval)::int) FILTER (WHERE e.event_code = '0209') AS online_sec,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM substring(e.event_message FROM 'Stop:\s*([0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})')::interval)::int) FILTER (WHERE e.event_code = '0209') AS stop_sec
  FROM machine_target m
  JOIN public.machine_event e 
    ON e.equipment_id = m.eqp_id 
   AND e.event_code IN ('0209', '0201')
   AND e.event_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT 
  to_char(d.prod_date, 'MM/DD') AS "ShortDate",
  to_char(d.prod_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "FullDate",
  UPPER(to_char(d.prod_date, 'Dy')) AS "Day",
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  -- Shift 1 (08:00)
  '08:00' AS "Time1",
  COALESCE(to_char(MAX(s.hits) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 1), 'FM999,999,999'), '0') AS "Hits1",
  COALESCE(to_char((MAX(s.online_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 1) || ' seconds')::interval, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '00:00:00') AS "Online1",
  COALESCE(to_char((MAX(s.stop_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 1) || ' seconds')::interval, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '00:00:00') AS "Stop1",
  COALESCE(ROUND((MAX(s.online_sec - s.stop_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 1)::numeric / NULLIF(MAX(s.online_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 1), 0) * 100.0), 1)::text || '%', '0.0%') AS "Rate1",
  -- Shift 2 (20:00)
  '20:00' AS "Time2",
  COALESCE(to_char(MAX(s.hits) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 2), 'FM999,999,999'), '****') AS "Hits2",
  COALESCE(to_char((MAX(s.online_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 2) || ' seconds')::interval, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '****') AS "Online2",
  COALESCE(to_char((MAX(s.stop_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 2) || ' seconds')::interval, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '****') AS "Stop2",
  COALESCE(ROUND((MAX(s.online_sec - s.stop_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 2)::numeric / NULLIF(MAX(s.online_sec) FILTER (WHERE s.shift_num = 2), 0) * 100.0), 1)::text || '%', '****') AS "Rate2"
FROM dates d
LEFT JOIN shift_agg s 
  ON s.eqp_id = d.eqp_id 
 AND s.prod_date = d.prod_date
GROUP BY d.eqp_id, d.prod_date
ORDER BY d.prod_date DESC;
